items.title: Voice / spoken lines
items.notes: Normalize spoken lines to this level. Stays above SFX and music in the final mix.

items.title: Music and ambience loop
items.notes: Lowest layer of the mix. Loop with a short fade at each loop boundary, never a hard cut.

items.title: Final true peak ceiling
items.notes: Measured after every layer (voice, SFX, music) is combined, not per-layer.

items.title: Small-build audio scope
items.voice_policy: one locked voice per speaking entity, reused consistently
items.notes: SFX priority order: primary verb, damage/feedback, pickup/reward, one environmental cue, one ambience layer.
